identity: Green-White Human tribal go-wide aggro: cheap Human bodies and token generators (Gather the Townsfolk, Join the Dance, Torens) scaled up by the cube's two true Human anthems (Mayor of Avabruck, Hamlet Captain) and closed out by Crusader of Odric, Odric Lunarch Marshal, and Butcher's Cleaver.
